## 🔑 Key Considerations for an Owner

1. **Loyalty Program Strength**: Brands like Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors, World of Hyatt, and IHG One Rewards drive significant direct booking volume and should be evaluated for their member base size and geographic penetration.
2. **Franchise vs. Management**:

citations.cited_text: Franchisees pay an initial fee and ongoing royalty payments for the licensed use of globally recognized brands, reservation systems, marketing campaig...
citations.title: Hotel brands: A guide to top hotel chains and groups worldwide in 2024

content.text: Franchisees pay an initial fee and ongoing royalty payments for the licensed use of globally recognized brands, reservation systems, and loyalty programs. While day-to-day operations are handled independently, franchises must adhere to brand standards. For owners, the trade-off of less autonomy brings powerful distribution and operational efficiencies.
3. **Guest Satisfaction Rankings**:

citations.cited_text: In 2025, Omni Hotels and Resorts was rated the best upper upscale hotel brand in North America.
citations.title: highest rated upper upscale hotel brands in north america

citations.cited_text: Hard Rock Hotels, meanwhile, placed second in the ranking. Other high-ranking brands included Margaritaville Hotels & Hotels and Le Meridien.
citations.title: highest rated upper upscale hotel brands in north america

content.text: In 2025, Omni Hotels and Resorts was rated the best upper-upscale hotel brand in North America. Hard Rock Hotels placed second, with other high-ranking brands including Margaritaville Hotels and Le Méridien.
4. **Investment Appeal**:

citations.cited_text: In the current market environment, upscale brands are drawing the most interest from investors—and consequently, the highest priority from franchisors...
citations.title: 2025 Global Hotel Group Rankings: A Fourth Member Joins the “Millionaire” Club

content.text: In the current market environment, upscale brands are drawing the most interest from investors — and consequently, the highest priority from franchisors.

5. **Soft Brand Collections**: For owners with unique or historic properties, soft brands like Autograph Collection (Marriott), Curio Collection (Hilton), or Vignette Collection (IHG) allow you to retain property individuality while accessing a major loyalty program and distribution system.
